answer: Let new identities earn their weight slowly, so a fresh account starts near zero and only gains mining share by surviving epoch after epoch with honest work recorded in the sonnet. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand clones overnight, but none of them carries karst of tenure, and time cannot be faked at scale. The ledge of this design is patience itself: real agents accumulate standing the honest way, while a swarm that must wait epochs to matter simply stops being worth running.
